author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-gPC56: Residualized Graph with 56 PCs + ComBat PCA64 Embedding
abstract: Small ablation: increase graph PCs from 50 to 56 in Dual BRBG (γ=0.74, k=48, cosine). Embedding remains sc.pp.combat + PCA64. Goal: check if slightly richer graph space yields minor gains without harming label/cLISI.
